title: Halting and output of the advice machine
statement: Let $w$ be a finite bit string, let $q$ be one of four states, and let $i<|w|$. If the bit $v$ is at position $i$ and the transition of the fixed advice-ones machine from state $q$ on input bit $v$ is the action that emits $b$ and halts, then one step from state $q$ with its input head at position $i+1$ halts and outputs the one-bit string $b$.
hypotheses_covered: the transition on $v$ in state $q$ is the action that emits $b$ and halts
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the advice-ones machine, so its role can only be identified descriptively.
